content: Aging for UDS status bits ”confirmedDTC” and ”test- FailedSinceLastClear” Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide the capability to age both the confirmedDTC bit and the testFailedSinceLastClear bit after a configurable number of aging cycles has been reached. The value at which each bit is aged may be different between the two. Rationale: – Use Case: – AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
